articles.title: Why Trump's claim of falling food stamp use might not mean the economy is improving

highlights: Trump claims 600,000 Americans have left food stamp rolls in nine months, attributing this to economic strength at multiple public events.
Data complexity shows declining SNAP participation doesn't necessarily indicate economic improvement, as low-wage workers still face a slowing job market and persistent inflation.
Food banks report increasing demand despite falling official food assistance numbers, suggesting continued economic hardship for many Americans.
Available SNAP data only runs through June with figures still subject to revision, indicating potential volatility in the metrics Trump is using to tout economic success.

articles.title: How Doug McMillon kept Walmart on top
articles.description: Outgoing Walmart CEO Doug McMillon has steered the retailer through the e-commerce revolution, a pandemic, high inflation and political upheaval.
highlights: McMillon transformed Walmart over 12 years by maintaining its low-price reputation while embracing technology to compete effectively against e-commerce rivals.
"McMillon has been a transformational leader who embraced technology to modernize WMT's operating model," noted RBC Capital Markets analyst Steven Shemesh.
Walmart has maintained market dominance as America's largest retailer and grocer with 4,600+ physical locations, while also becoming an e-commerce powerhouse.
McMillon navigated multiple economic challenges including the pandemic, high inflation and political pressures while keeping the company at the top of American retail.
